input: Build a simple floating shelf for the entryway

gold.taskTitle: Build a floating shelf for the entryway
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to build and install a simple floating shelf in their entryway.

questions.title: What width and depth do you want the shelf?
questions.description: Understand the exact dimensions the user has in mind for the shelf.

questions.title: What material are you planning to use?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants wood, MDF, plywood, or another material.

questions.title: What is the wall type in your entryway?
questions.description: Find out if the wall is drywall with studs, concrete, brick, or another type, as this affects mounting hardware.

questions.title: What weight will the shelf need to hold?
questions.description: Clarify the intended load so the correct brackets and fasteners can be chosen.

questions.title: What height on the wall should the shelf sit?
questions.description: Determine the mounting height for practical use and aesthetic placement.

questions.title: Do you already own tools like a drill and level?
questions.description: Establish what tools the user has available versus what they may need to acquire.

questions.title: What finish or look are you going for?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a natural wood finish, paint, stain, or something else to match the entryway decor.
